chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, from 'Umar ibn Hanzalah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about al-madhy, and he said: In my view, it is nothing but like phlegm.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the Imam being asked for the ruling
key_terms.الْمَذْيِ: pre-seminal fluid asked about in the legal question
key_terms.عِنْدِي: in my view; indicating the Imam’s expressed ruling
key_terms.كَالنُّخَامَةِ: like phlegm; a comparison indicating its legal status in context

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on al-madhy according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a question to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning al-madhy and conveys his ruling by likening it to phlegm. The narration is used in discussions of ritual purity, indicating that al-madhy is not treated as a substance carrying the same impurity ruling as semen.
